1. Executive Decision
Platform thesis:

BuildUp is an AI-Native Business Transformation Intelligence & Operating Platform. It sits above existing systems of record and turns business data into evidence, decisions, approved actions, measurable outcomes, and continuous learning.
Target market:
One platform serving the entire progression from UMKM/small business to mid-market, large enterprise, and holding/conglomerate structures through progressive packaging, not separate products.
Core loop:
SENSE → DISCOVER → DECIDE → ACT → PROVE → LEARN.
Non-negotiable:

A page is not considered built merely because the UI exists. A capability is production-ready only when its data path, permissions, backend behavior, audit trail, failure states, tests, and real integration are verified.
2. Current-State Audit Summary

The existing repository has a credible React/Vite/TypeScript UI, Firebase configuration, Express backend, Firebase Admin token verification, Gemini integration, official BuildUp logo assets, and a useful set of enterprise modules.

Current identity/session behavior still contains prototype logic: client-side user objects and localStorage session state, with login/register functions that do not perform real Firebase authentication.

Current tenancy/data model is too small for the intended SaaS: users, organizations, health_checks are insufficient for membership, resource authorization, lineage, genome, decisions, transformations, outcomes, knowledge, and commercial entitlements.
The admin API route is authenticated but does not enforce an admin permission at the server boundary.
The AI strategic-analysis route is not protected by requireAuth and directly calls Gemini; this must be replaced by the governed AI Gateway.
Business context contains hard-coded demo metrics/decisions and Health Check dimension calculation uses Math.random(); production metrics must be deterministic, sourced, versioned, and traceable.
Supabase migration artifacts remain in the repository although the strategic platform direction is Google/Firebase-first; legacy paths should be frozen, migrated where needed, and retired.
Pricing/UI variants have diverged across the current builds; this blueprint establishes one canonical commercial architecture.

7. Productized Diagnostic Offers
Health Check — Free / waived. Purpose: qualification and directional assessment only. Must clearly label results as directional when data is self-reported.

Business X-Ray — Recommended paid diagnostic layer. Deep diagnostic, root-cause analysis, evidence-backed bottleneck map, leakage hypotheses, 90-day transformation agenda. The current AI Studio screenshot showing a Rp 45 juta/project X-Ray concept can be retained as the canonical diagnostic price only if commercially validated before launch.

Transformation — Project-based execution. The current AI Studio screenshot shows Rp 150 juta/project as a concept; retain as a configurable list price, subject to service scope, complexity, and verified commercial policy.

Business OS — Continuous intelligence and orchestration. The current AI Studio screenshot shows Rp 90 juta/project as a concept; this blueprint converts the recurring operating platform into an entitlement-based package with monthly/annual commercial configuration rather than a misleading one-time project label.

Important catalog reconciliation: the older web pricing variant contains Standard Rp 6 juta/month and Growth Rp 28 juta/month. Those should be the canonical recurring tiers. The X-Ray/Transformation/Business OS figures become modular productized services that can be sold alongside or above recurring plans, rather than competing alternative plan catalogs.
8. Billing & Entitlement Model

Plans are product definitions; subscriptions determine customer status; entitlements determine what the customer may use; metering measures consumption; invoice/payment records determine financial state.
Entitlements must be enforced server-side for users, AI calls, connectors, document volume, storage, reports, agent runs, workflow executions and support level.
Annual billing discount is a commercial configuration; UI must calculate and display annual equivalent without duplicating plan definitions.
Gain-share requires an outcome baseline, measurement window, attribution method, approval/acceptance record, and verifiable evidence.

Never promise 'guaranteed ROI' unless an actual contractual mechanism defines what is guaranteed. Replace marketing copy that implies unconditional guarantee with 'ROI measurement and evidence-based value tracking' unless legally approved otherwise.

10. Business Genome
Definition:

The Business Genome is BuildUp's living model of how a business works. It should answer: what exists, how it connects, what matters, what changed, where constraints sit, what risks exist, and which levers can move outcomes.
Every Genome entity is versioned and source-linked.
A Genome change emits an event and invalidates/recomputes affected insights.
All AI agents consume a governed Genome/context snapshot rather than uncontrolled page-level context.
The Genome must support tenant-specific ontology extensions while preserving a canonical BuildUp ontology.
11. Universal Data Fabric

Connector families: Google Workspace; accounting; ERP; CRM; HRIS; banking/fintech; POS; procurement; REST/GraphQL; webhooks; SFTP; SQL; CSV/XLSX/JSON/XML; PDF/DOCX/PPTX; scanned documents; manual forms/interviews; public/industry intelligence.
Every connector: credential/scopes, data classification, schema mapping, sync schedule, incremental/backfill strategy, rate limit, retry, idempotency, health, ownership, and audit.
All ingestion is observable and traceable with correlation IDs, source timestamps and lineage.
AI claims require evidence provenance: source, time, transformation path, scope, and confidence.
Data quality: completeness, duplicates, schema drift, temporal gaps, outliers, reconciliation failures and stale sources.
12. Intelligence Engine
Deterministic metric layer before AI reasoning.
Versioned Health Score and X-Ray scoring models with explicit formulas and calculation traces.
Anomaly detection and variance analysis.
Root-cause graph: symptom → evidence → cause → driver → intervention.
Forecasting with assumption sets and confidence ranges.
Scenario and counterfactual simulation.
Benchmark engine with cohort definition, normalization, privacy thresholds and evidence quality.
Recommendation engine creates Decision Objects; AI never silently executes a consequential business action.
13. AI Gateway & AI Workforce
All model calls go through one governed AI Gateway. No page/component may call Gemini or another provider directly.

Gateway stages: authentication → tenant/policy resolution → data classification → context assembly/retrieval → model routing → tool authorization → structured output validation → confidence/evidence checks → approval gate when required → execution → outcome capture → audit.
Model routing is task-aware: extraction/classification vs reasoning vs retrieval/embedding vs specialized computation.
Each AI agent has: objective, scope, tools, permissions, autonomy level, KPI, budget, escalation threshold, owner, version, evaluation set.
Autonomy levels: L0 observe; L1 recommend; L2 act with pre-approval; L3 bounded autonomous execution.
High-impact finance, tax, legal, HR, payment, security and irreversible actions require explicit human approval.
Prompt injection and data exfiltration defenses are part of the AI Gateway, not optional agent-specific add-ons.
14. Decision Engine
Decision Object fields: problem, evidence, assumptions, options, expected impact, downside/risk, confidence, owner, authority, required approvals, action plan, execution status, outcome link.
Approval policies are machine-readable and versioned.
Use materiality thresholds, segregation of duties, dual-control for sensitive actions, and immutable-ish audit history.
Execution must be idempotent and support rollback/compensation where possible.
A decision is not 'executed' until the actual system integration confirms the action.
15. Transformation OS
Transform insight into initiatives with hypothesis, baseline, target, owner, budget, milestones, dependencies, risks and value assumptions.
Workflow engine supports retries, timeouts, compensation, escalation, human handoff and notification.
Every transformation artifact links back to decisions and forward to outcomes.
Executive view should show plan vs actual, value realization, blockers and required decisions.
16. Outcome Ledger
Separate estimated value, expected value, realized value, cash realized and avoided loss.
Each value event stores baseline, intervention, period, actual, attribution model, evidence, confidence and owner.
Gain-share billing reads from approved/verified outcome records.
Counterfactual comparisons should show what happened versus baseline/expected trajectory, including assumptions and uncertainty.
17. Knowledge Graph & Learning
Store reusable knowledge as graph nodes/edges: symptoms, causes, industries, interventions, outcomes, constraints, failure modes, policies and playbooks.
Playbooks are versioned and linked to evidence.
Learning loop evaluates which recommendations and interventions actually improve outcomes.
Benchmark datasets use strict cohort, anonymization, minimum-size and contract/consent governance.
Customer data remains customer data; cross-customer intelligence requires explicit legal/governance controls.
18. Security & Privacy Architecture
Firebase Auth/Identity Platform for identity; Firebase Security Rules/App Check where client SDKs access Firebase services; server IAM for server-side access.
Tenant isolation: organization membership is the source of tenant authorization; no client-supplied organization ID is trusted without policy evaluation.
RBAC + ABAC, deny-by-default, privileged action audit logging, least privilege.
Secret Manager for server secrets and API credentials.
Security headers/CSP, rate limiting, payload limits, input schema validation, dependency and secret scanning.
Data retention, export, deletion, consent and incident response workflows.
Backups and restore tests are required; disaster recovery objectives are documented per service tier.
For enterprise/private deployments, support SSO/SAML/OIDC, private networking, customer-managed integration scopes and enhanced audit exports.
19. Google / Firebase Reference Architecture
Firebase Authentication / Identity Platform
Cloud Firestore for application state and event-adjacent records where suitable; use a relational store where complex relational integrity/reporting warrants it.
Cloud Run for backend/API microservices and long-running HTTP services.
Cloud Functions/Eventarc/Pub/Sub for event-driven tasks and orchestration.
Cloud Storage for documents/raw evidence with tenant-bound paths and signed access.
BigQuery for analytical workloads, benchmark computation, historical outcome analysis and product analytics.
Vertex AI / Gemini for model access through BuildUp's AI Gateway.
Cloud Scheduler for recurring jobs; Secret Manager; Cloud Logging/Monitoring/Error Reporting; Artifact Registry; CI/CD.

Server-side authorization and tenant isolation penetration tests passed.
Admin access denied to non-admin users at API and UI levels.
AI Gateway is the only production model entry point.
All production metrics are sourced or explicitly labeled synthetic/demo.
Health scoring is deterministic, versioned and reproducible.
Core domain migrations and indexes tested on representative datasets.
At least one real connector works end-to-end with retries/idempotency and provenance.
Document ingestion and evidence retrieval work end-to-end.
Decision approval and execution paths are durable and auditable.
Transformation workflows recover correctly from failure.
Outcome Ledger records baseline/target/actual/attribution.
Billing/entitlement/metering webhooks are idempotent and enforce limits.
Logs, metrics, traces, alerts, backups, restore tests and incident procedures are operational.
Accessibility, responsive behavior and all route/deep-link cases tested.
Security scans and dependency audits pass.
Privacy/legal/commercial documents are ready for the actual launch jurisdictions.
Real-client pilot completes a full journey from data → insight → decision → action → outcome.
